cards.front: Recall a key point about Research Methods
cards.back: Experimental designs: independent measures, repeated measures, matched pairs; controls: standardisation, counterbalancing, random allocation

cards.front: Recall a key point about Research Methods
cards.back: Sampling: random (unbiased), stratified (proportional subgroups), systematic (interval), opportunity (convenience), volunteer (self-select)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Research Methods
cards.back: Descriptive: mean (parametric), median (skewed), mode (nominal), SD (spread), range; Inferential: t-test, Mann-Whitney, Wilcoxon, Chi-squared, Spearman, Pearson

cards.front: Recall a key point about Research Methods
cards.back: Ethics: consent, deception (cost-benefit), debrief, withdrawal, confidentiality, protection from harm; BPS code

cards.front: Recall a key point about Research Methods
cards.back: Reliability: consistency (test-retest, inter-rater, split-half); Validity: internal (IV->DV), external (generalisable), ecological (real-life), construct (measures concept)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Research Methods
cards.back: Report structure: Abstract (150w), Intro (lit review, hypothesis), Method (design, sample, materials, procedure), Results (stats, tables), Discussion (interpret, eval, implications), Refs (APA)
